name: moonshift-mods
description: Claude Code mods for building Moonshift Studio apps: studio board, secret guard, the Moonshift skin, Agent Watch and Token Saver.

plugins.name: studio-board
plugins.description: /studio opens a panel with every Moonshift app's status and links plus a studio to-do list; /todo adds to it.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude from writing secret keys into code or committing and pushing them, and keeps .env files out of git.

plugins.name: moonshift-skin
plugins.description: Moonshift look: night-shift spinner words, a gold shift-done line and the app you're working on in the footer.

plugins.name: agent-watch
plugins.description: /agent-watch opens a panel that lists every agent in the session, what each one is doing right now, its model, and how far along it is.

plugins.name: token-saver
plugins.description: Spends fewer tokens: helper agents run on a cheaper model, browser screenshots are taken smaller, and /handoff moves a long chat to a fresh one. /saver shows and switches each part.
